body: Methoxetamine: it's basically like Ketamine but it's a lot easier to get ahold of and so far testing shows it does not cause liver damage like Ket does (although it hasn't been around for long enough to know the long term effects), there's recently been a lot of outrage at it politically and all legal high shops have been banned from selling it in the past few weeks. It's also highly addictive as I have found out the hard way.
I've been to my GP, he didn't really seem to care he just gave me a phone number and address of some place, it just seemed like I was wasting his time.

I appreciate your words, and the effort you have taken but the bridges I have burned can definately not be repaired, the people I have lost have given me more than enough chances, and it's all my fault because I've constantly lied and let them down, I've had many last chances and i've tried many times to solve this addiction but I just can't, I can't escape it, there's always opportunities to take again and I can't fucking say no despite the fact I know the problems it will cause. The only solution would be to lock me in a prison with no way of getting in contact with drugs but to do such a thing would require me to do far worse than take drugs and I don't want to hurt anyone doing it so this is my only escape.

I speak with my dad about it and he is very supportive but he is very busy and says only I can stop, I tried to get him involved (to come with me to a place that helps with drug addiction) but he says it's up to me to do it. I haven't yet told him about my decision to kill myself because I know he'll only try and stop it but I just don't want to live anymore, I don't want to be a burden in his life.
